sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:30

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:30:1
items.html: The first one emanated them in the phase of back to back etc., the first one made and emanated all their Partzufim etc.: The first illumination is HGT and the covered NHY, and the second illumination is the revealed NHY, as above. And he says that the first illumination can be called both by the name face and by the name posterior; and likewise the second one can be called by the name face and by the name posterior. For from the side that the first illumination is the very emanation of the whole Partzuf, it can be called by the name face; and further, that the HGT are the anterior vessels, which in Gadlut [greatness/adulthood] become HBD. And likewise it can be called by the name posterior, because of the state of back to back in them. In the same way, the new illumination can be called by the name face, even though it is only the phase of NHY, since these NHY, by being revealed, drew the face to face of ZON. And they can be called by the name posterior, since they are the phase of the completion and the enlargement of the posterior, that is, the NHY, as above.
